name: Jinko Holdings Limited
summary: Jinko Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, development, production, and marketing of photovoltaic products. The company provides solar modules, silicon wafers, solar cells, recovered silicon materials, and silicon ingots. It offers solar system integration services; solar power generation and solar system EPC services; and energy storage system, as well as undertakes solar power projects. The company sells its products to distributors, project developers, system integrators, and manufacturers of solar power products under the JinkoSolar brand.
